evidence: Adds microbenchmarks and synthetic block generation utilities in src/bench/ for TxIndex, TxoSpenderIndex, and BlockFilterIndex under the Tests label.
rationale: Adds sync and lookup microbenchmarks for index subsystems so developers do not need full IBD to evaluate performance changes. The harness provides clear utility for measuring index scaling against transaction counts and has already been used to evaluate open optimization PRs like #35531 and #34489.
